comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: 2026-10-17: the refusal's reason now prints (c8db68c0), in this assert and in two others that dropped it (the CLI's messaging tests, the bridge's link.rs). The CLI's messaging:: tests ran 25 times throttled at load 4-10 with no failure, so which refusal it was is still unknown; the next sighting in a gate will say.

comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: 2026-10-24: not reproduced in 12 full CLI suite runs, three at a time at load 10, with the daemon binary given a new inode before each round to force macOS's first-exec assessment. Candidates unchanged: begin_replacing, or a 10 s STEP in handoff/mod.rs running out.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: 2026-10-05, in ./release minor's gate for 0.14.0 at load 11.8, right after the version bump rebuilt every binary: crates/muster-cli/tests/cli/messaging.rs:466 asserted daemon.replace(None).outcome() == Done and got Refused. Passed 5/5 alone and in the gate an hour before, on unchanged daemon/handoff code. The assert drops the answer's reason, so which refusal it was (begin_replacing, or a STEP of 10 s timing out while macOS scanned the fresh binary) is unknown. First make the assert print the reason; then decide whether the handoff's step patience or the test is wrong.
title: 🎲 a_followed_log_prints_each_entry_as_it_lands_across_a_handover saw its handover refused
